The listings here include checkpoint inhibitors, engineered immune cells, intratumoral immune treatments and other approaches intended to help the immune system recognize or attack cancer. 39 current studies and treatment programs in this category Some studies combine immunotherapy with surgery, chemotherapy or radiation. The exact drug or cell product, diagnosis, disease stage and previous treatment all matter. Intratumoral immunotherapy for canine oral malignant tumors VetAgro Sup — Service of Cancerology · France Current study listed by VetAgro Sup CICV with a study-specific owner appointment route What is being offered: VetAgro Sup and FINDIMMUNE study intratumoral treatment of canine oral melanoma and oral squamous cell carcinoma: 10 visits over six months, injections at days 1/30/90 and follow-up at days 7/15/60/120/150/180. A selection visit confirms diagnosis. The CICV current-studies index links this protocol. Detailed stage/weight/metastasis/prior-treatment filters are retained conservatively from Oncowaf, not represented as independently primary-confirmed; study-team prescreening is required. Who may qualify: Confirmed cancer diagnosis required; Active tumor required; Measurable; Min weight kg: 5; No metastasis May not qualify if: Current steroids; Prior chemo; Prior local radiation; Prior immunotherapy Costs / coverage: The study treatment is free and medical follow-up is fully covered. The initial selection/diagnostic visit and travel costs are not specified; confirm with VetAgro Sup. Contact: Oncology appointment: +33 4 78 87 26 70; CICV study questions: cicv@vetagro-sup.fr Location Centre hospitalier universitaire vétérinaire des animaux de compagni
